summary: A Waybar module that shows the current battery charge percentage, colours the label amber below 30 percent and red below 15 percent, refreshes the reading every 30 seconds, and opens a desktop notification stating whether the battery is charging or discharging when the module is clicked.
targetUsers: Waybar users on laptops who want the battery charge and charging state visible in their status bar
goals: Show the current battery charge percentage in the Waybar module label
Colour the label amber below 30 percent and red below 15 percent
Refresh the battery reading every 30 seconds
Open a desktop notification stating the charging state when the module is clicked
nonGoals: No historical battery charts or long-term logging
No low-battery alerts or notifications triggered automatically by the threshold
No detection of a reading that is only valid for one calendar day

features.name: Battery percentage label
features.userOutcome: See the current battery charge percentage in the Waybar module, coloured by the stated thresholds
features.trigger: The Waybar module re-reads the cached label on its fragment interval
features.behavior: The module command with no action or --once never measures the battery; it re-reads the cached label and renders it with the class derived from the stored reading: class critical below 15 percent, class warning below 30 percent, otherwise class normal. The label is the whole-number percentage followed by the percent sign. When no reading was ever stored the label is -- with class empty. When the last refresh failed the cache keeps the last good label text with class stale, and the module output rendered from that cache is that text with STALE_SUFFIX appended and class stale.
features.failureOutcome: With no stored reading the label is -- with class empty; after a failed refresh the last good label text is shown with STALE_SUFFIX appended and class stale
acceptanceSignals: A stored reading of 42 renders the label 42% with class normal
A stored reading of 25 renders the label 25% with class warning
A stored reading of 9 renders the label 9% with class critical
With no stored reading the module output is -- with class empty
After a failed refresh the module output is the last good label text with STALE_SUFFIX appended and class stale

features.name: Battery refresh
features.userOutcome: The module keeps showing a fresh battery percentage and charging state without any manual action
features.trigger: The --service loop runs every 30 seconds, and --action refresh runs on demand
features.behavior: Each refresh reads the battery charge percentage and charging state from the system source, then writes the single stored reading record with the percentage, the charging state, and the sample time as a UTC epoch in whole milliseconds. The cache is written with the formatted label text and class as soon as the fetch succeeds; the bar re-reads that cache on its next fragment re-run. When the fetch fails the cache keeps the last good label text with class stale and no stored record changes.
features.failureOutcome: The cache keeps the last good label text with class stale and no stored record changes; with no reading ever stored the label is --
acceptanceSignals: The refresh pass returns an interval of 1800 seconds
After a successful refresh the stored reading record holds the measured percentage, the charging state, and a sample time in whole milliseconds
After a failed refresh the cache keeps the last good label text with class stale and no stored record changes

features.name: Charging state notification
features.userOutcome: Click the module and get a desktop notification saying whether the battery is charging or discharging
features.trigger: A click on the Waybar module
features.behavior: A click reads the stored battery reading record and sends a desktop notification whose body states the stored charging state: charging, discharging, full, not charging, or unknown. With no stored record the click sends nothing and exits non-zero.
features.failureOutcome: With no stored record the click sends no notification and exits non-zero
acceptanceSignals: With a stored charging state of charging the click sends a notification whose body states charging
With a stored charging state of discharging the click sends a notification whose body states discharging
With no stored record the click sends no notification and exits non-zero

dataObjects.name: Battery reading
dataObjects.purpose: The latest measured battery charge percentage, charging state, and sample time
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Keeps only the latest reading; each refresh replaces the single stored row

qualityRequirements: The label shows the percentage as a whole number followed by the percent sign, for example 42%
The label class is normal at or above 30 percent, warning below 30 percent, and critical below 15 percent
productConstraints: The module command with no action or --once never measures the battery and only re-reads the cached label
A reading reaches the bar only at the next fragment re-run after the cache write
